risks_update.before: - **R15 (열림 — 伏図 중점 문턱의 여백 불성립·블록 오탐)** phase 42에서 중점 거리 `alongDistance`의 채택 최댓값과 미채택 경쟁 최솟값을 계측했다. step 0 시점의 **36면·208개 채택 스팬**(반환 격자와 블록의 축 열 합집합)에서 **A = 10.379846pt**는 `saiki-p2`의 X `2–1`, 치수 `700`이고, **B = 0.018265pt**는 `hirosaki-p25`의 Y `Y8–Y9`, 치수 `24000`이다. 따라서 **`A ≤ 15 < B`는 성립하지 않는다.** A는 파서가 채택한 값의 극값이지 정답 스팬의 인증이 아니며, 해당 `saiki-p2` 후보는 뒤의 step 1에서 제거됐다(`phases/42-plan-grid-soundness/step0-report.json#/corpus`·`#/midpoint_margin`; `phases/42-plan-grid-soundness/step1-report.json#/census/removed/1`).

steps: Run from repository root. Recreate the following temporary file as UTF-8; its code instruments a copy of the current parser exclusively in memory and never writes to src/.
Enumerate all sorted *.json textitems fixtures, require 36 pages, hash each input, and pass {...fixture.page, items: fixture.items} to both baseline and observed parsers.

Capture normalized dimension text and the actual selected token objects at all three successful validateSequence returns. Preserve partial-total original axis option indices. Track gridCandidate origins by object identity.

Take the union of internal directed sequence objects actually present in output.grids and output.blocks xGrid/yGrid. Count each returned sequence once per page; do not count suppressed or discarded sequences.

For each selected token use abs(token[alongKey] - (left.positionPt + right.positionPt)/2). Keep product direction separate from page alongKey. Do not reconstruct dimension strings from numeric values or apply extra coordinate corrections.

For B, exclude selected span token objects and use the original adjacent axes across-window options, with no midpoint cutoff. Compare the minimum across all spans and the subset with totalConfirmed=false.

Require exact equality of all 36 full parser outputs and unchanged input/parser text. Report the maximum, coordinates, per-page hashes and all measured span rows. The earlier report is read only afterwards for comparison.
Remove the temporary replay file and its JSON output after inspection. The replay code is preserved here for future independent reruns.

citations.value: golden_identical은 corpus2.test.ts의 CASES 7면에 대해 parseFramingPlan 반환 객체 전체(grids, blocks, issues, 좌표·축척·배치·제목 포함)를 배열 순서까지 T=15와 정확 비교한 값이다. 골든 파일과의 계약 대조는 sweep_details.golden_pages.matches_golden_contract로 별도 기록한다. T=30은 tsu-p16의 issues만 달라 전체 동일성은 false지만 골든의 블록 계약은 통과한다.
